comment: The owner-approved exceptions to tools/ci/check_claims.py (docs/ci.md, 'The claims'). A page may not say that the program is certified, qualified, compliant, approved or guaranteed. An exception names one file and the words around the word, and says why the use is not a claim. An exception is approved when approved_by holds the name of the person who approved it; check_claims.py --strict fails while one in use is not. Only the owner fills in approved_by.
